title: nano-rave-drag1 pipeline parameters
description: ONT amplicon variant calling and P. falciparum drug-resistance genotyping

input.help_text: One row per ONT sequencing run; any number of runs may be given. 'sequencing_dir' is the flowcell output directory containing fastq_pass/. Generate with bin/make_run_samplesheet.sh. 'run_name' must match ont_multiplex_group in the sample-sheet workbook.

reference_manifest.description: CSV with columns: reference_id,reference_path (one row per amplicon reference FASTA)

min_barcode_dir_size.description: Skip barcode directories smaller than this (MB)
min_barcode_dir_size.help_text: Unused barcodes on a 96-plex flowcell still collect stray reads. If EVERY barcode is filtered out the run fails loudly rather than silently producing nothing.

variant_caller.description: Variant caller. clair3 is the validated path for this assay.

clair3_model.description: Clair3 model directory. Required for --variant_caller clair3; must match the basecaller chemistry.
clair3_model.help_text: The pinned Clair3 image only ships R9.4.1 models. This data is R10.4.1, so the bundled r1041_e82_400bps_sup_v430 model is used by default.

clair3_args.help_text: --no_phasing_for_fa and --include_all_ctgs are required or Clair3 emits no genotypes on small Pf amplicons (its phasing/contig filters assume human chromosomes). --haploid_precise because P. falciparum is haploid.

drug_resistance.description: Run the drug-resistance analysis stages (coverage QC, genotype calls, frequencies, summary tables)

samplesheet.description: Sample metadata workbook (.xlsx). Its ont_multiplex_group column must contain the run_name values used in --input.

plot_metadata.description: Clean specimen-level ecological metadata CSV used only by the publication-figure module.

plot_geo_dir.description: Directory containing ghana_ADM0.geojson and ghana_ADM1.geojson for the surveillance map.

resources.description: Analysis resources: amplicon positions, DR variant info, genetic code, k13 annotation and the WHO kelch13 catalogue

multiplex_sheet.description: Sheet name inside the metadata workbook

min_cov.description: Amplicon median coverage AND per-SNP depth threshold
min_cov.help_text: Was 50x during the retired feasibility phase, which left dhfr callable in only 27.7% of samples.

analysis_date.description: Date stamp used in analysis output filenames (defaults to today)

cohort_name.description: Label for the pooled cohort, used in analysis output filenames
cohort_name.help_text: The resistance analysis pools every flowcell in --input into a single cohort, so this names the combined sample set rather than a flowcell.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to the output directory

validate_params.description: Validate parameters against the schema at runtime
